notes: First מִפְּנֵי fuses to 'before' (rule 30); second is split because 'face' is written for פָּנֶה. 'Neither' goes to the waw under rule 35 since the negative is gapped in the second line. 'thick darkness' heads on 'darkness' by rule 31's tie test, the ASV writing bare 'darkness' for חֹשֶׁךְ in the same verse.
